# GraphQL contract fixture

`swapi.graphql.txt` is the unmodified SDL published by the
[SWAPI GraphQL application](https://github.com/graphql/swapi-graphql/blob/8c0bf5868f11fe84942548180751fceeb36bd606/schema.graphql),
at revision `8c0bf5868f11fe84942548180751fceeb36bd606`, retrieved 2026-11-06.
Its MIT license is preserved in `LICENSE`.

- Size: 35,868 bytes.
- SHA-256: `ebc4d09b21e2aec2735d6f0d3c812fc017cd49a44900dd3ae34f49f6f8c25133`.
- The `.txt` suffix protects the original bytes from source formatters.

This is a published application contract, not captured runtime traffic.
Owned operation documents and malformed variants are separately constructed
by tests. Parsing this fixture does not establish endpoint reachability,
authorization, operation execution or complete server behavior.
